name: Descriptive Norm Reactance
fact: Descriptive norms can lead to norm reactance and backlash from male employers when they are informed that others have hired more women.

provenance.title: Descriptive norms and gender diversity: Reactance from men
provenance.quote_or_locus: In fact, descriptive norms do not affect female employers’ hiring decisions at all and lead to norm reactance and backlash from male employers when informed that others have hired more women
